primary_change.before:
type Feature interface {
	Name() string
	Discover(cfg *NodeConfiguration) bool
	InferForScheduling(podInfo *PodInfo) bool
	InferForUpdate(oldPodInfo, newPodInfo *PodInfo) bool
	MaxVersion() *version.Version
}

blast_radius_shape.reasoning: In Go, removing a method from an interface ONLY breaks code that calls that method THROUGH the interface type. Concrete types that implement the method keep it and still satisfy the (now smaller) interface — they do NOT fail to compile. The only non-test call site for InferForScheduling through the Feature interface is framework.go line 94: `if f.InferForScheduling(podInfo) {` where `f` is of type `Feature`. This is a compile error because `Feature` no longer has that method. Three test files call `.InferForScheduling` on concrete type variables (not through the Feature interface), so they compile fine. The blast radius is thus a single file: framework.go.
